items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 2:1
items.html: Since the Galgalta was corrected in the aspect of a ring, namely in the concealed Hassadim of the first three of Bina, the power of the screen in the mouth of Atik does not rule over it, but only over its lower seven and below, which are the aspect of YESHSUT, which need the illumination of Hochma for the sake of ZON. Hence these lower seven were divided and came out of the aspect of the Galgalta and descended to the level of the Sealed Brain, and they are called the upper Sealed Brain within the Galgalta, or the Avir that sits upon the Sealed Brain. For they descended to the level of the Sealed Brain; but the first three of the Galgalta are called Avir dakia, for the power of the screen does not rest upon them at all, and they are clean of the power of restriction. As in Answer 1 above. (Page 310, Item 35).
